summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, a routine Hong Kong monthly return of equity issuer movements for the month ended September 30, 2026, submitted to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong and dated October 7, 2026. The filing reports no change in authorized share capital (USD 50,000 total), issued shares (932,053,942 Class A; 54,814,423 Class B), or treasury shares (40,454,099), and confirms compliance with the 15% minimum public float requirement. No special-situation event, transaction terms, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; this is an ordinary listing-rule compliance report with no deal or arbitrage angle.
